name: anchor-x402-mcp
description: 14 pay-per-call USDC tools on Base mainnet, $0.001–$0.05 per call — nine commodity primitives (hash anchoring, OFAC sanctions screening, signed decision attestation, tx + calldata decode, ENS/SNS resolution, USD token price, datetime parser, bundled wallet intel) and five universal LLM endpoints (roast, oracle with anchored verdict, tldr, aura, grade). Auto-pay via `x402-fetch` + `viem`; configure one `ANCHOR_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY` env var, no API keys. Every signed payment authorization is hard-capped in code at $0.05 to anchor's treasury with a bounded validity window, so a compromised endpoint cannot drain the configured wallet. Install: `npx anchor-x402-mcp`. MIT.

notes: The local stdio package uses ANCHOR_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY to sign bounded x402 payments. The remote endpoint returns x402 payment requirements for paid tool calls.
The local stdio package documents 14 tools; the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint returned 18 tools during maintainer review on 2026-09-23. Paid tool execution was not tested.
